{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./glotzerlab_build.flux.sh [args...]`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Preserve original arguments
ARGS="$@"

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --ntasks=1         -> -n 1
#   --cpus-per-task=32 -> -c 32
#   --time=8:00:00     -> -t 8h
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 32 -t 8h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner $ARGS")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  shift

  # NOTE: Slurm --job-name=... not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm --account=dmr140129 not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require account/project out-of-band.

  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=shared not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the shared partition.

  export OUTPUT_FOLDER=$PROJECT/software/conda
  unset CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH

  module reset
  module load gcc/11.2.0 openmpi/4.1.6

  export CC=$GCC_HOME/bin/gcc
  export CXX=$GCC_HOME/bin/g++

  flux run -n 1 -c 32 ./build.sh "$@" \
      --skip-existing \
      --variants "{'cluster': ['anvil'], 'device': ['cpu'], 'gpu_platform': ['none']}" \
      --output-folder "$OUTPUT_FOLDER"

  chmod g-w "$OUTPUT_FOLDER" -R
fi
"
}
